text: Every RLS role starts in the exact same place: Desktop's Manage Roles dialog, on the Modeling tab.
Six steps, always in this order. Name the role, pick the table to filter, write the filter, and save. Desktop never lets you assign a user here — that's strictly a service-side step.
The simplest possible filter — a static value. Only rows where Region equals West stay visible to anyone in this role.
The moment you need something dynamic — filtering by the signed-in user themselves — you switch to the DAX editor. These three functions are the common patterns.
One role, one filter, defined in Desktop. Lesson 81 covers what happens after you publish it — assigning real people to it in the service.
